original_title: Three Games Are Confirmed For Xbox Game Pass To End The Month (July 28-31)
summary_en: Xbox Game Pass is adding three new titles to its library before the end of July. The highly anticipated campaign for a major shooter finally leaves its premium early access phase.
ai_analysis: This week's Game Pass additions highlight Microsoft's strategy of leveraging major first-party releases alongside diverse third-party content to drive subscription value.

en.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Finally Hits Game Pass This Week
en.summary: Xbox Game Pass is adding three new titles to its library before the end of July. The highly anticipated campaign for a major shooter finally leaves its premium early access phase.
en.body:
The final stretch of July is set to bring some exciting new additions to the Xbox Game Pass roster, offering subscribers a fresh batch of games to dive into. While the service consistently adds new titles, this particular wave includes a significant first-party release that fans have been eagerly awaiting.


## Major Campaign Drops for Game Pass

The headline act for this Game Pass update is undoubtedly **Halo: Campaign Evolved**, which officially departs its premium early access period and becomes available to all Game Pass subscribers on July 28th. This release marks a crucial moment for the franchise, bringing the full campaign experience to a wider audience after a period of more limited access. The game has already garnered considerable praise for its engaging gameplay and narrative, making its inclusion a massive win for the service. Beyond the iconic Master Chief, the Game Pass library will also see the arrival of two other titles, rounding out a strong week for players. While specific details on the other two games are still emerging, the focus remains firmly on the return of a beloved shooter's campaign.


## What This Means for Halo and Game Pass Fans

For the dedicated Halo community, the full campaign's arrival on Game Pass is a cause for celebration. It ensures that this latest chapter in the saga is accessible to a vast number of players, potentially reigniting conversations and fostering new engagement around the franchise. The move also underscores Microsoft's commitment to making its flagship titles a core part of the Game Pass value proposition. This strategy has proven effective in attracting and retaining subscribers, as evidenced by the consistent demand for major releases to be included day one or soon after their initial launch. The inclusion of **Halo: Campaign Evolved** is a clear signal that Game Pass remains the premier destination for fans of Microsoft's biggest franchises.


## What's Next

With **Halo: Campaign Evolved** launching on July 28th, Xbox Game Pass subscribers have a major title to look forward to. The other two confirmed games are expected to roll out shortly thereafter, with players encouraged to keep an eye on official Xbox announcements for precise release times and details. The end of July promises a strong finish for the service.

content_raw: Two of them being huge additions! The final week of July is approaching! We've got three titles set to join Xbox Game Pass over the next few days, and considering they're spread out, we thought we'd round them up in this article to ensure you don't miss anything. Of course, Halo: Campaign Evolved is the big highlight - a game we've been having a blast with here at Pure Xbox , and one that's finally coming out of its Premium "early access" period on July 28th.
